provenance: Developer-authored scripted transcript replays. Not recorded conversations or a held-out human evaluation. Currency amounts follow each pack's storage units (USD cents). Scenarios prefixed 'field-' are verbatim turns from a real field session rather than developer-authored examples. Scenarios prefixed 'shona-chatter-' replay Sahara v2.5 transcripts of 17 unscripted clips recorded by the native Shona validator (Ruwa 17-35); they are controls asserting nothing is logged. Ruwa 23 and 24 returned empty transcripts and never reach the agent (the API answers 'please try again'), so they are not replayed.
